item.title: Why are RAM prices so high right now? - Engadget
item.summary: # Why are RAM prices so high right now? And when will they come back down again? In the last 18 months, the price of RAM has [skyrocketed](https://pcpartpicker.com/trends/price/memory/), and is expected to [continue rising](https://x.com/pequityresearch/status/2069119897817223620/photo/1) for the rest of the year. For something that's gotten cheaper pretty [consistently](https://aiimpacts.org/trends-in-dram-price-per-gigabyte/) since the '60s, the dramatic spike now is all the more unprecedented. There's a reason everyone's calling this the RAMpocalypse, because what used to be a cheap commodity has become a luxury item. It's why you're left having to pay more for every new phone, PC and tablet from now and for a long while to come. ## What is RAM? RAM, or Random Access Memory, is a crucial component of every computer, enabling it to read and execute data effectively. In order to work, your CPU needs a steady supply of information to process, information which is stored on its hard drive.
